title: Q19 Sequence of statements on hobbies
subject: Polity
caption: Logical sequence of statements P, Q, R, S describing hobbies and their significance
altText: A top-to-bottom flowchart starts with a Start node, then follows the ordered statements: P – Reading expands knowledge, Q – Painting nurtures creativity, R – Running improves health, S – Volunteering builds community spirit, leading to a Summary node that highlights how hobbies enrich personal growth, and finally an End node.
